Quarterly content review (SPEC §10b Maintain). Opened automatically by
`.github/workflows/scheduled.yml`. Update what changed, then close this issue.

## Checklist

- [ ] Roles and experience: new role, end dates, highlights and metrics
- [ ] Projects: status (running / completed / pending), links, new projects
- [ ] Skills: add or retire items, adjust levels
- [ ] Certifications: e.g. CKA status, dates, credential links
- [ ] Achievements and updates: anything worth a post since last quarter
- [ ] Resume: replace `public/resume.pdf` if it changed
- [ ] Profile: location, open-to-work flag, contact links
- [ ] Screenshots: refresh the README screenshot/GIF if the UI changed
- [ ] Analytics: check GoatCounter for unused sections or commands and file follow-up issues

Use the **Content update** issue template for anything that needs its own PR.
